action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves at depth 4, then select a verified candidate.
action.rationale: Broad search is required and no prior analyses exist. With White up a knight for a pawn (material advantage from the Nxb4 line), I want full coverage to confirm the best continuation and check for tactics like Nxf7, Nd7 forks, or Nc6 hitting the e6 bishop. All 40 legal moves will be scored at depth 4 within the 3000-node analysis allowance.
